name: Java Build Runner

mkdir -p logs

variables.name: GitHub Repository URL
variables.description: The URL of the GitHub repository to clone.

variables.name: Java Version
variables.description: The Java version to use for building and running the project.

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: The branch of the repository to clone. Default is 'main'.

variables.name: Run File
variables.description: Name of the JAR file to run after build.

variables.name: Git Username
variables.description: Username for HTTPS access. Optional for GitHub tokens.

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Token for HTTPS access (GIT_AUTH=token or auto). Prefer a fine-grained, read-only token. Leave empty for public repositories or deploy keys.

variables.name: Git Access Method
variables.description: auto (token if set, else deploy key if present, else anonymous), token, deploy_key (SSH key generated on first start, add its public key as a read-only deploy key) or none (public repository).

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: true: fetch, reset to the branch (or DEPLOY_REF) and rebuild on every start. false: start the JAR already built.

variables.name: Deploy Ref
variables.description: Optional tag or commit to deploy instead of the head of the branch, e.g. v1.4.0.
